messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I need to create a fun, recognizable illustration. Let me think about the composition:

- A bicycle: two wheels, frame, handlebars, seat, pedals
- A pelican: large body, long beak with pouch, wings, legs on pedals, sitting on the seat

I'll use simple shapes and colors to make it charming and recognizable. Let me build this step by step.

Bicycle:
- Two circles for wheels with spokes
- Frame lines connecting wheels
- Handlebars at front
- Seat area

Pelican:
- Oval body sitting on the seat
- Long curved beak with throat pouch
- Eye
- Wings
- Legs reaching to pedals

Let me design coordinates carefully:

Canvas: 400x300

Bicycle wheels: rear wheel at (140, 220) r=40, front wheel at (310, 220) r=40
Frame: connecting lines from rear axle to seat area to front axle
Handlebars: at top of front fork going up to about (290, 150)
Seat: around (190, 140)

Pelican body: sitting on seat, oval around (200, 110)
Beak: extending forward from head
Head: around (240, 90)
Beak pointing forward: long beak from head to about (320, 100)
Wings: curved shapes on the body

Let me lay this out properly with viewBox="0 0 400 300".

Wheels: rear (130,210) r45, front (300,210) r45
Spokes: lines through center
Frame: rear axle (130,210) to seat (185,135) to head tube (270,140) to front axle (300,210), plus chainstay rear axle to bottom bracket (215,195), seat tube seat to bottom bracket.

Handlebars: head tube top (270,140) to handlebar grip (295,110)

Seat at (185,135), pelican sits on top of seat.

Pelican body: ellipse cx=210, cy=100, rx=45, ry=30
Head: circle cx=255, cy=85, r=18
Neck connecting body to head: could use a path
Beak: long triangle from head forward: from (270,80) to (325,95) with pouch curve below
Eye: small circle at (258,82)
Legs: from body bottom to pedals
Pedals: at bottom bracket (215,195) with crank arms

Wings: a curve over the body, like folded wing shape.

Colors: pelican body white-ish with grey, beak orange/yellow, bicycle blue/red.

Let me write the SVG carefully. I'll include a background sky and ground maybe for charm. Keep it clean.
answer:
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" width="400" height="300">

  <ellipse cx="200" cy="262" rx="180" ry="18" fill="#d8e7d0"/>

  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="130" cy="210" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="6"/>
  <circle cx="130" cy="210" r="6" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
  <g stroke="#9a9a9a" stroke-width="2">
    <line x1="130" y1="210" x2="130" y2="168"/>

    <line x1="130" y1="210" x2="160" y2="240"/>
  </g>

  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx="300" cy="210" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="6"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="210" r="6" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
  <g stroke="#9a9a9a" stroke-width="2">
    <line x1="300" y1="210" x2="300" y2="168"/>

  </g>

  <!-- frame -->
  <g stroke="#e04a3f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <line x1="130" y1="210" x2="185" y2="135"/>   <!-- seat tube-ish -->
    <line x1="185" y1="135" x2="270" y2="140"/>   <!-- top tube -->

  <circle cx="215" cy="195" r="9" fill="#e04a3f"/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d="M270 80 L325 92 Q322 96 318 96 L272 90 Z" fill="#f2a24d" stroke="#d07c2c" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- throat pouch -->
  <path d="M272 90 Q306 104 322 94 Q300 116 272 100 Z" fill="#f6c47c" stroke="#d07c2c" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- subtle shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="215" cy="270" rx="90" ry="6" fill="#00000010"/>
</svg>
```
